nodes.asset_description: Composite fashion mood board collage on a light gray background. Elements include: a photo of a person in a light gray hoodie (torso view); a black hoodie product cutout; a white chunky sneaker product cutout; pale blue high‑waisted straight‑leg jeans; a gray cropped crewneck sweatshirt; a ribbed dark-olive cropped tank with a black hand‑drawn circle and arrow pointing to the strap; a small handwritten note reading 'silver hardware?' near the tank; another handwritten note reading 'find this bucket hat' with a curved arrow pointing to a model in a bucket hat and oversized black jacket; two fabric swatch squares in charcoal; a photo of a person in a long black coat walking away, encircled by rough black hand‑drawn rings; a model posing in a bucket hat and layered black outfit, also circled; a tan baseball cap product cutout; a hand holding black sunglasses; a pair of black oval sunglasses product cutout; a pair of glossy black loafers with tassels; a portrait of a woman with long hair wearing rectangular black sunglasses; multiple black doodles including brush strokes, loops, circles, arrows, and a short wavy line; a taupe paint‑dab near the bottom right. All items have soft drop shadows consistent with collage styling.
